releases.name: opencode-swarm-lite v2.0.0
releases.body:
# opencode-swarm-lite v2.0.0

First public release of the **adaptive multi-model agent orchestration runtime for OpenCode** — cost-aware scheduling, mixed execution strategies, provider routing, crash recovery, and benchmarked parallel speedups.

## Highlights

- **4.98× clean parallel-subset speedup** — serial 68.07 min vs swarm 13.67 min (86.1% parallel efficiency)
- **2.68× corrected whole-arm speedup** — 155.02 vs 57.78 min; the predictor estimated 1.66×
- **Six adaptive topologies** — `SERIAL`, `SMALL_SWARM`, `FULL_SWARM`, `SPECULATIVE_SWARM`, `PIPELINE`, `BATCHED_WORKER`
- **Nine-field predictor contract** driving every scheduling decision (snake_case, stable)
- **Crash recovery** — coordinator recovery, durable run manifest, provider portfolio routing
- **991 tests passing**, typecheck clean, CI workflow included

## Honest disclosures

- The **raw** whole-arm run of **658.3 min** is excluded from headline numbers due to an overnight provider outage — methodology and raw vs corrected figures are in [`docs/BENCHMARKS.md`](docs/BENCHMARKS.md).
- **Negative result included:** on the small task, serial (~293 s) *beat* swarm (~439 s / ~589 s). The runtime publishes this and uses it to drive cost-aware decisions.

## Install

```bash
npm install opencode-swarm-lite
```

Or from a source checkout:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Arihant-Bharanidharan/opencode-swarm-lite.git
cd opencode-swarm-lite
bun install
bun run typecheck
bun run test
```
